title: HubSpot Implementation Specialist (Remote)
job_description:
Your Job

Build revenue engines in HubSpot for small and medium-sized businesses.

As a KLA Group HubSpot Implementation Specialist, you turn client sales and marketing goals into solutions inside HubSpot. You’ll onboard new clients and work continuously with existing clients to build, manage, and improve their HubSpot portals. That includes campaigns, sales sequences, pipelines, workflows, segmentation, landing pages, dashboards, automation, AI tools, and the other elements that help clients fully leverage the power of HubSpot.

This is not a behind-the-scenes role. You’ll collaborate directly with our team and clients to understand how their business runs, identify gaps and opportunities, recommend solutions, and then implement them. As a go-to HubSpot resource, you’ll help clients get more from the platform and use it to drive measurable results.

Your work directly impacts how clients gain traction and grow.

Who You Are

You’re a HubSpot certified expert who enjoys figuring out how to make HubSpot work better for clients and then doing the hands-on work to make it happen. You build the campaigns, workflows, sequences, dashboards, automations, and other elements that bring sales and marketing together into a revenue engine. When something isn’t working, you don’t leave it. You fix it, refine it, and make it better.

People rely on you because you’re organized, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple clients at once. You stay current on HubSpot certifications, test new features, embrace AI, and look for better ways to use the platform. You follow through and care about getting the details right for your coworkers and our clients.

You want a role that is:

Hands-on, technical, and strategic
Client-facing and collaborative
Focused on building systems that drive results

You’re not looking for:

A role focused only on campaign execution
Data entry or routine HubSpot administration
A siloed back-end role with little client interaction
A software development role focused on custom applications or large-scale integrations

Who We Are

KLA Group is a HubSpot Gold Partner and B2B sales and marketing agency that small and mid-sized companies call on when they’re tired of chaos. We focus on the full revenue engine bringing sales, marketing, and HubSpot together to help clients gain traction and grow. When clients partner with us, things start to click. What used to feel scattered becomes clear, steady, and easier to manage.

Our team is remote, but no one is alone. We talk to each other throughout the day, sharing client work alongside updates from vacations, conferences, and what we did over the weekend. Good work gets kudos. When someone needs help, the whole team is ready to step in. We take our work seriously and still have fun doing it.

This is a full-time, remote work position for someone who wants to be an active part of our team. You do not have to reside in Denver but must live in the continental United States.

Your Responsibilities

Develop and execute ongoing HubSpot implementation plans that align with the client's business goals.
Configure and customize HubSpot, including contacts, deals, pipelines, sequences, workflows, segmentation, landing pages, reports, and dashboards to meet client requirements.
Migrate data from other CRM systems to HubSpot and assist with WordPress to HubSpot website migrations.
Troubleshoot, clean up, and improve existing client portals, identifying opportunities to better leverage HubSpot.
Train clients on how to use key HubSpot features and recommend best practices based on their sales and marketing processes.
Collaborate with KLA and client sales and marketing teams to align requirements and ensure on-time, accurate implementation.
Integrate HubSpot AI features and tools (e.g., predictive lead scoring, AI agents) to improve targeting, segmentation, conversion rates, and sales and marketing productivity.
Continuously learn, evaluate and test HubSpot AI features and tools, recommending and applying them to improve targeting, performance, and overall sales and marketing efficiency.
Manage multiple client implementations and ongoing projects, keeping work organized, accurate, and on schedule.
Stay up to date with HubSpot features, updates, certifications, and best practices to provide expert advice and recommendations.

What You Bring:

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, information technology or equivalent experience.
HubSpot certifications in Sales, Marketing, and Content Hub (Professional or Enterprise.)
3+ years of hands-on implementation experience in an agency environment supporting multiple clients, including:
Implementing HubSpot for new clients, including portal setup, data migrations, workflows, and automation
Setting up, testing, managing, and monitoring HubSpot campaigns, workflows, sequences, dashboards, and landing pages
Using HubSpot’s AI-driven features and tools
Troubleshooting and improving existing client portals
Explaining technical concepts and recommendations to non-technical clients
Managing multiple clients and implementation projects at once
3+ years proven success in sales and marketing automation.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and work one-on-one with clients.
Commitment to continuous learning in HubSpot AI, marketing automation, and CRM best practices.
Strong understanding of the integration between marketing, sales, and customer service processes.
You enjoy hands-on HubSpot implementation. This is not a software development role focused on custom applications or large-scale integrations.

Bonus You May Bring:

Have developed new websites in HubSpot CMS and / or WordPress
Certified and experienced in HubSpot Service Hub
Experience with Google Analytics and email platforms such as Constant Contact and MailChimp

Pay: $85,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Benefits:

401(k)
Dental insurance
Health insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Retirement plan

Work Location: Remote
